notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Cleansing Fire has at least two indestructible counters on it.
Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter on it.
description:
Activate Myojin of Cleansing Fire by removing an indestructible counter from it, destroying each other creature.
When Park Heights Maverick dies, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cleansing Fire and Myojin of Grim Betrayal.
Activate Myojin of Grim Betrayal by removing an indestructible counter from it, putting Park Heights Maverick and any other creature that died this turn from each player's graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
